posts.author: Fomar0153
posts.body:
Individual Turn Battle System
Version 1.1
by Fomar0153
​
Description
Implements a battle system where your action takes place straight after your input.
Features
Customisable turn order formula.
The option to do away with the Party Command Window (though you will need to add some other method of escape if you do... My next plugin is likely to be an escape command that can go on the actor window).
Screenshots
How to Use
Place the plugin in your project's js/plugins/ folder.
Inside RPG Maker MZ's editor, open the Plugin Manager.
Create a new entry and select this plugin from the list.
Customise the options to your liking and then click ok.
Download
Click here.
FAQ
Q: Nothing seems to happen when I use your plugin or I get an error.
A: Make sure the plugin has its original name and that you haven't accidentally renamed it.
Q: I double checked the name and I still have an error.
A: Please be really specfic about what you did when the error occurred, hit F8 and it'll give you some more details that might be useful to me. Does it happen in a blank project?
Credits
Fomar0153
Terms of Use
As long as I am credited, you may use this plugin in your projects both commercial and non-commercial.
Version History
1.0 -> 1.1 - 31/08/20
Fixed bugs relating to restrictions on status effects.

posts.author: shukrin
posts.body:
I've been looking at various battle system but still I always ended up liking this more except that there is a bug that causes it to not show any slip damage popup. I tried to contact the author since last month but to no avail. So today i decided to try fix it myself (with 0 javascript experience of course!!)
this is the plugin:
Individual Turn Battle System
bluecoralgames.com
my general strategy was to look into the default plugin mainly the "manager" one and compare to this plugin and see what did he changed.
From my observation, I'm guessing that slip damage coming from "displayRegeneration" which is rooted from "displaybattlerstatus". "Displaybattlerstatus" is used for "BattleManager.updateTPB".
I looked on his plugin, and his "BattleManager.updateTPB" is changed and doesnt have "displaybattlerstatus". So i just copy the "this.displayBattlerStatus" and pasted it there. It doesn't work at first. Then I tried to change the "battler" term to the one which fomar used.
I battled tested and somehow it worked, slip damage appeared but I am really insecure with what i did and worried if it will give complications later especially with me just randomly doing it.
So, I just need help from anybody experienced to check and confirm for me what I did is right or not, did i really solve the problem? will it cause more problem?
Thanks
